# Test fixture dependency

`cleave.min.js` is the actual public input-formatting library referenced by the supplied Linode HTML snapshots. It is used only in the offline payment-form test, with fictitious test card values, and is not used by the extension.

Source: https://login.linode.com/static/js/cleave.min-07963935.js

Upstream: https://github.com/nosir/cleave.js (Apache-2.0)
